name: attendance-ms
description: Attendance system split into NestJS microservices (learning project)

scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --config apps/auth/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config apps/shift/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config apps/attendance/prisma.config.ts && prisma generate --config apps/notification/prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate: prisma migrate dev --name init --config apps/auth/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate dev --name init --config apps/shift/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate dev --name init --config apps/attendance/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate dev --name init --config apps/notification/prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:deploy: prisma migrate deploy --config apps/auth/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config apps/shift/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config apps/attendance/prisma.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config apps/notification/prisma.config.ts
scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n tsc,gateway,auth,shift,attend,notify -c gray,cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm:build:watch" "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:auth" "npm:dev:shift" "npm:dev:attendance" "npm:dev:notification"
